name: three-entries
description: One 30-minute interval of 0.412 kWh (824 W) starting 2026-09-29T01:00:00Z written as three back-dated entries, memory size 4032; the example of [01] 6.2 with the third entry in range. Requests are replayed in order on one running instance; address 0 is what Eve writes first.

format.intervals: the ledger input, in order: start instant (Z), durationMinutes, kwh of imported energy
format.overflow: intervals whose average power exceeds 6,553.5 W: no entries are written for them
format.entries: every entry fed to fakegato-history addEntry({ time, power }) in this order: time is Unix seconds at the end of its 10-minute slot (start + 600 k), watts is the power given, deciwatts = watts * 10 is the 16-bit field value
format.restartAfterEntry: null, or the number of entries after which the instance was dropped and a new one loaded the persisted file
format.beforeRestart: null, or historyStatus, historyEntries and state read before the restart
format.afterRestart: null, or historyEntries and state read right after the reload, before any further entry
format.historyStatus: E863F116 bytes (hex, little-endian fields) as published after the last entry
format.historyEntries: in replay order on one running instance: for each History Request, the address requested, the exact E863F11C bytes written (hex: 01 14, u32 address, 00 00) and every E863F117 read (hex) until the terminator 00
format.state: the library counters after the last entry: firstEntry, lastEntry, usedMemory, refTime (first entry time minus epoch), initialTime
